note: Original geometry except the credited Eiffel Tower, Liberty and Christ adaptations. References inform proportions and features. Source credits, licenses, checksums and adaptation notes are retained alongside imported assets.

repairs.china: Posts shortened; conforming saddles stay outside the disc radius; face ornaments clear the jade surface.
repairs.japan: Hollow collars replace solid blocks around posts; hanging papers attach to a curved rope; front plaque layers meet without crossing.
repairs.united-states: Hollow bell shell and integrated casting bands; support tops meet yoke underside; fracture decoration follows the shell surface.
repairs.france: Imported footing rests on the circular base surface; source lattice and platform joins retained.

designNotes.chile: Original moai sculpted as one continuous carved surface (brow, eye sockets, long nose, pursed lips, chin, ears, arms and long-fingered hands as relief) with painted weathered tuff and lichen, on an original fitted basalt ahu with a poro pebble apron and a shore diorama. Not a survey reconstruction.
designNotes.argentina: Obelisco miniature on a stepped pedestal whose front carries an original ornamental Sun of May: thirty-two alternating straight and flame rays, framed in laurel. Abbreviated original inscription arrangement, not a facsimile of all four historic inscriptions.
designNotes.spain: Artistic interpretation of the planned eighteen-tower scheme, not the current construction state: spindle apostle towers with painted helical louvres and red-and-white mosaic pinnacles under small white crosses, Evangelist towers with white horn crowns, Mary’s star, the Jesus Christ cross, Nativity, Passion and Glory facades and an octagonal Eixample block.
designNotes.italy: Artistic reconstruction of surviving and ruined fabric, with partial arena decking to show the hypogeum.
designNotes.korea: Original five-by-five-bay Geunjeongjeon hall interpretation with stone terraces, painted brackets, a lower skirt roof rising into the upper storey and a hip-and-gable upper roof, each roof resting on its bracket sets.
designNotes.united-states: Adapted Metron3D scan of a replica, CC BY 4.0. Source pedestal leveled by its measured base plane, correcting a 4.2479-degree tilt with a rigid rotation; only the lowest contact strip flattened. Proportions and drapery retained, with a level atlas display base. Source attribution and license retained in the downloadable model.
designNotes.china: Original diorama of Ming wall architecture on an autumn mountain ridge: crest-following wall with stepped walkway, outer battlement and inner parapet, four two-level watchtowers (one with a tiled lookout), painted heightfield ground and individual trees. Not a survey reconstruction.
designNotes.reserved: Jade disc, celadon vase, Liberty bell and floral matryoshka retain exact existing model and poster bytes; no future quiz assignment has been made.
designNotes.russia: Original architectural miniature with eight clustered chapels, a central tent, later low chapel and belfry. Distinct modeled spiral and diamond dome patterns. Not a survey reconstruction.
designNotes.brazil: Adapted JuanG3D authored Art Deco sculpture, CC BY 4.0. Original print plinth removed; face, hands and layered robe retained. Uniformly scaled onto an original pedestal and summit terraces on an original Corcovado diorama (sheer streaked granite face, dense Atlantic forest, bay). Not a scan.
